caseName: Spencer v. South Carolina Tax Commission
caseNameFull: SPENCER et ux. v. SOUTH CAROLINA TAX COMMISSION
attorneys: Henry L. Parr, Jr., argued the cause for petitioners. With him on the briefs were Eric B. Amstutz and Frank S. Holleman III., Ray N. Stevens, Senior Assistant Attorney General of South Carolina, argued the cause for respondents. With him on the brief were T. Travis Medlock, Attorney General, and Joe L. Allen, Jr., Chief Deputy Attorney General.*

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Justice Powell took no part in the decision of this case.
